channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: India-US interim trade framework opens major export opportunities, says PM Modi
item.description: Taking to social media platform X, PM Modi said, "Great news for India and USA! We have agreed on a framework for an Interim Trade Agreement between our two great nations. I thank President Trump for his personal commitment to robust ties between our countries."

item.title: Amit Shah Orders Zero Infiltration, Calls for Elimination of Terrorists in J&K
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah chaired a high-level security review meeting in Jammu and directed security forces to eliminate all Pakistani terrorists active in Jammu and Kashmir while ensuring zero infiltration across the LoC and International Border.

item.title: Toxic: A fairytale for Grownups beats Yash's KGF: Chapter 2 record
item.description: Producer and distributor Dil Raju is said to have acquired the rights of Yash's Toxic: A fairytale for Grownups for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. He has shelled out Rs 120 crore on the same.

item.title: US to cut tariffs to 18% under interim trade pact, opening $30 trillion market for India, says Piyush Goyal
item.description: As part of this framework, the US will slash reciprocal tariffs on Indian goods to 18 per cent, providing a huge market opportunity in key sectors such as textiles and apparel, leather and footwear, plastic and rubber products, organic chemicals, home decor, artisanal products, and select machinery in the world's largest economy.

item.title: Cracks in Alliance: Coalition Partner Congress Trains Guns on Omar Abdullah Government
item.description: Despite being part of the ruling alliance, J&K Congress president Tariq Hamid Karra launched a sharp attack on the Omar Abdullah government in the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly, flagging the omission of statehood restoration from the Lieutenant Governor's address and raising humanitarian concerns.

item.title: 'Cheap & vulgar': Gaurav Khanna's wife Akanksha Chamola gets cosy, shares intimate dance with Kunwar Amar and Ali Hasan; faces backlash
item.description: BB19 winner Gaurav Khanna's wife, Akanksha Chamola, went viral for an intimate dance video from Dil Dhokha Aur Desire with co-stars Ali Hasan and Kunwar Amar, following which many drew comparisons to AP Dhillon and Tara Sutaria's situation.

item.title: 'Bright future is here': Virat Kohli, Gautam Gambhir praise India's U-19 World Cup champions
item.description: Sooryavanshi and Ayush Mhatre built a strong partnership, scoring 142 runs together, with skipper Mhatre contributing 53 off 51 balls. Sooryavanshi then took charge, scoring 175 runs off 80 balls, which included 15 fours and 15 sixes. He reached his century in just 55 balls and his 150 in 71. Late innings support from Kanishk Chouhan, who made 37 off 20, helped India to a total of 411/9.

item.title: U.S. Justice Department files detail Epstein's links to Anil Ambani?
item.description: Jeffrey Epstein maintained contact with Indian businessman Anil Ambani between 2017 and 2019, according to documents released by the US Justice Department. The messages show the two discussed global affairs, business and personal matters, and made plans to meet, including a confirmed meeting at Epstein's New York home in 2019. Epstein also showed interest in the Ambani family, ordering books about the business dynasty.

item.title: Thiruvalla spa sexual assault case: probe widens to police amid 'quotation' allegations
item.description: Preliminary findings indicate that some personnel attached to the Thiruvalla police station allegedly collected regular "monthly payments" from spa establishments. Investigators are also probing whether police officers were frequent visitors to several spas in the area, including the one where the assault occurred, and whether the accused received unlawful assistance.

item.title: Operation Sindoor: Amit Shah salutes BSF's bravery, lauds force as India's border shield
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Friday praised the Border Security Force for its courage and sacrifices during Operation Sindoor, saying the force has always stood as the nation's first line of defence in the most challenging times. He highlighted the destruction of Pakistani posts and terror launch pads, honoured fallen martyrs, and announced major welfare and modernization initiatives for BSF personnel.
